node.title: Re: DBI output into browser using CGI
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I don't have time for a comprehensive answer right now, but I did want to say this: Please read and follow [id://111088] as well as [http://bobby-tables.com/|Bobby Tables], your code is vulnerable to SQL injection! In regards to the latter, use [https://metacpan.org/pod/DBI#Placeholders-and-Bind-Values|placeholders] instead.

Debugging aids: [id://745674], [id://165253], [id://380424], and use CGI::Carp qw/fatalsToBrowser/;
